members.name: Jesse Cortez
members.backstory: Jesse ran the fry station at a roadside diner. He can tell when oil is ready by the sound. He did the same math every shift: what feeds people, fast. Hannah's kitchen rival. Quiet. The food is loud enough.

members.name: Theo Lindqvist
members.backstory: Theo led a trail crew in the national forest — six months a year of crosscut saws, switchbacks, and weather. He has slept under worse sky than this. His grandparents came from Winnipeg; he grew up hearing English at home, and still understand more than he can say. Leo's mentor. Teaches speedrunning. Of what, unclear.

members.name: Zoltan Nagy
members.backstory: Zoltan grew mushrooms in a converted barn, logs stacked to the ceiling. He knows mycelium like a friend and he talks to the logs daily. Grows mushrooms in the dark. Says they understand him.
